4 اوضحهُ , (S, Msb, K,) and اوضح عَنْهُ, (L,) inf. n. إِيضَاحٌ: (TA,) and ↓ وضّحهُ , (K,) inf. تَوْضِيحٌ; (TA;) He rendered it apparent or plainly apparent, overt, conspicuous, manifest, notorious, plain, obvious, or evident; (S, L, K;) rendered it clear, or unobscured; exposed it to view; displayed it; laid it open; disclosed or uncovered it. (Msb.) ―
-b2- He rendered language perspicuous. (The lexicons, passim.) ―
-b3- اوضحت الشَّجَّةُ فِى الرَّأْسِ The wound upon the head laid bare the bone. (Msb,) [See مُوضِحَةٌ.] ―
-b4- اوضح لَهُ الأَمْرَ, (S, K,) and الكَلَامَ, (S,) He made the affair, (S, K,) and the language, (S,) plain, or clear, to him. (S, K.) ―
-b5- See 1. ―
-b6- اوضح قَوْمًا He saw a people. (L.) ―
-b7- اوضح He (a man) had white children born to him: (S, L:) and in like manner one says [اوضحت] of a woman. (L.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
